_comment: Made-to-order goods (issue #131 phase 1): game seconds a customer waits at the machine while the item is made, added to the time at the shelf (the mix in the machine is its stock: it keeps 2 days, then it is wasted). Initial values.
_comment_130: Issue #130 phase 1: a pizza is baked to order (300 s at the oven). Fresh bread is baked into the oven's showcase trays when restocked (the restock is the bake) and keeps 8 hours; what is left is wasted.
